body.p: Earlier the fox was black, big as a wolf. The fox went along the shore of the river; going it met a burbot that was living at the shore of the river. The fox said to the burbot: "Let us run a race in the river reach." "Well, let's race", the burbot said, "just wait a bit for me. I'll come here soon, wait a bit for me!" The burbot went off. The burbot went to its relatives and said: "When the fox is shouting, answer [him] in the front." So the burbot persuaded all its relatives. It was not long and the burbot came to the place where the fox was, and it said to the fox: "Well, let's run a race!" "Go", the fox said. The burbot plunged [into the water], and there it was. The fox was running. Having crossed one river reach, the fox shouted: "Burbot!" "Hoj, hoj!", the burbot answered behind him. The fox was happy and said [=thought]: "I am running [away]." The fox ran, it ran far, it stopped and shouted: "Burbot!" That one at the river reach answered: "Hoj!" The fox ran at full power, it ran through a river reach, it crossed a cape, it ran down to the river, it shouted to the burbot. Again that one [the burbot] answered there at the river reach. The burbot didn't swim, it stayed there. The was ran, it ran until it became red brown. Until now it has become red brown, it has become clever and smart.
